concept.observed: A life from birth to death told along one horizontal line: a heartbeat spike opens on a baby, then childhood, teenage sunset, adult city routine, love, family, old age at night, and the line goes flat.
concept.interpreted: Emotional short about time; the line is both heartbeat and the ground walked on.

communication_style.observed: No words except HUD numbers (age and heart rate in the top corners).

palette.observed: Each stage has its own palette: warm daylight, pink-orange sunset, grey city, warm interior, deep blue night; measured overall luma 0.37.
palette.interpreted: Colour as a clock of a lifetime.

shapes_and_materials.observed: Flat vector characters and scenery with simple shading.

motion.observed: Characters walk along the line; scenes slide or dissolve as the walk continues; hamster wheels and clocks for routine.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Measured boundaries 1.57 c, 3.92 c, then soft changes at 5.33, 10.10, 11.73, 14.05, 16.80 s; median shot 2.35 s.

transitions.observed: Re-read 2026-11-27: 7 boundaries (0 cut, 2 grow, 3 cover, 2 continuous). 1.57 s grow: concentric red and yellow rings bloom from the character in about 0.27 s (1.44-1.71 s) and the next landscape is seen through the inner ring. 3.92 s cover: a rainbow diagonal band sweeps right to left in about 0.2 s (3.83-4.03 s); day becomes a neon night behind it. 5.33 s continuous: the character rides on; nothing changes. 10.10 s cover: grey shelving panels slide away to the left (9.94-10.21 s) and reveal a beige room with the couple inside a ring. 11.73 s grow: a small heart above the couple already holds the next scene's sky and grows past the frame edge in about 0.27 s (11.50-11.77 s); the street scene shows through it (30 fps strip 11.50-11.84 s). 14.05 s cover: a ragged organic edge wipes from right to left in about 0.3 s (13.93-14.22 s), day to dusk. 16.80 s continuous: night holds while the moon rises and the couple age. Earlier reading (2026-10-30): Heartbeat-to-circle bloom (1.57 s); soft walking transitions; a ragged organic edge wipe late in the piece.
transitions.interpreted: Every life stage turns through a shape from the story (rings, a heart, a torn edge); no hard cut in 20 s.

depth_and_layering.observed: Flat layers with mild parallax in landscapes.

audio_and_sync.observed: 4.4 onsets/s, tempo low confidence; 57% of boundaries near onsets (chance 36%).

motifs.observed: The line; the age and BPM counters.

sound_design.observed: Integrated -14.2 LUFS, LRA 3.3 LU, true peak -0.6 dBTP. 18 accents (54 a minute). Accents on cuts 0.14 against chance 0.16 (7 boundaries); onsets near boundaries 0.57 against 0.36. No silences; head -0.2 dB, tail -3.4 dB. Listen sheet: the first accents are the heartbeat blips on the line (0.30, 0.81 s), then the baby appearing (1.25 s), the child's ball bouncing (2.81, 3.30, 3.58 s), skateboard landings (4.32, 4.83, 5.32 s) and the clock jumping hours (7.31, 7.83, 8.82 s).
sound_design.interpreted: Sound follows the life events (heartbeats, bounces, clock jumps), not the scene changes.

narration.observed: 1 word in 1 phrase (7.10-7.35 s) over the commuter scene; no speaker on any phrase frame; 1-2 word 'phrases' are dictation noise over the music. Verdict: none.

captions.observed: None; copy is a top-centre clock and weekday counter and small corner counters; no caption lane.

scenes.observed: Flat heartbeat line on dark; a spike.
Red circle bloom on a baby; childhood landscape.
Teen sunset; adult grey city with clock and wheels.
Love and family scenes in warm colours.
Old couple at night; the line returns flat.
